title: Report Details
prompt: A short factual block that identifies the company, the assessment event, its date and type, and who took part from the company and from the advisory side.
required_items: the company's name, business ID and location
the date and type of the assessment meeting
the participants from the company and from the advisory side, with their roles

title: Executive Summary
prompt: A concise summary of the company, its current AI maturity, the prioritised use cases and the main recommendations, in a few paragraphs.

title: Company Overview
prompt: What the company does: its business, services, size, locations, customers and the strategic drivers behind its interest in AI.

title: AI Maturity Level
prompt: The company's current use of AI and related automation, its digital foundations, and a classification of its AI maturity as Low, Moderate or High, with the reasons for it.
required_items: the AI maturity classification: Low, Moderate or High

title: Current Solution Development Stage
prompt: Whether the company is at the ideation, prototyping or implementation stage, or already has an AI product in use, and what has been done so far toward it.

title: Identified Use Cases and Prioritisation
prompt: The AI use cases that were identified, how they compare, and which one is prioritised first and why.

title: Validity of Concept and Authenticity of Problem Addressed
prompt: Whether each use case addresses a real, measurable business problem, and how practical and feasible the proposed concepts are.

title: Integration and Importance of AI in the Idea
prompt: How central AI is to each use case and how important it is for solving the problem, and how it would fit into the company's existing systems and work.

title: Identified Target Market and Customer Segments
prompt: The company's customer segments and how clearly they are defined, and which of them the AI use cases serve.

title: Data Requirement Assessment
prompt: The data each use case needs, whether the company has it, in what form and how far back, and what limits its use.

title: Data Collection Strategy
prompt: Whether the company has a strategy for collecting, storing and using data, and what it consists of if it exists.
required_items: whether the company has a strategy for collecting, storing and using data

title: Technical Expertise and Capability
prompt: The company's in-house technical skills and development capability, and what it depends on partners or vendors for.

title: Risks, Compliance and Responsible AI
prompt: The main risks, regulatory and contractual constraints, and responsible-use concerns that affect adopting AI.

title: Budget and Funding
prompt: What the company has invested in AI so far, what it is willing to invest next, and what funding options it is considering.
required_items: the budget the company has indicated for AI investment
the funding options the company is considering

title: Expectations from FAIR Services
prompt: What the company expects from the advisory service and from the next phase of cooperation.

title: Recommendations
prompt: Recommendations that follow from the assessment, as practical, specific points that combine analysis with guidance, in the order they should be taken up.

title: Next Steps and Action Items
prompt: The next steps agreed or proposed, with who is responsible for each and when, where stated.

title: Appendix: Sources
prompt: A list of the source materials the assessment draws on, described by what each one is.
